results.name: shop/redis

error.Text: Deployment shop/redis has 1 replicas but 0 are available with status running

results.details:
Error: The Redis deployment in the "shop" namespace has 1 desired replica, but none are currently running.

Solution:
1. Check pod status: `kubectl get pods -n shop`
2. View pod logs: `kubectl logs <pod-name> -n shop`
3. Describe pod: `kubectl describe pod <pod-name> -n shop`
4. Fix issues (image, resources, config)
5. Restart: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/redis -n shop`

results.name: shop/redis-data
results.details:
Error: The StorageClass named "fast-ssd" doesn't exist in your Kubernetes cluster.

Solution:
1. List existing StorageClasses: `kubectl get sc`
2. Either use an existing StorageClass OR
3. Create "fast-ssd" StorageClass with proper provisioner config
4. Apply: `kubectl apply -f storageclass.yaml`

error.Text: 0/3 nodes are available: pod has unbound immediate PersistentVolumeClaims. not found

results.details:
Error: Pod cannot start because it needs storage (PersistentVolumeClaim) that isn't available or bound to any storage volume.

Solution:
1. Check PVC status: `kubectl get pvc`
2. Create PersistentVolume matching PVC requirements
3. Verify StorageClass exists
4. Check PVC binds to PV
5. Redeploy pod

results.name: shop/redis

error.Text: Service has no endpoints, expected label app=redis

results.details:
Error: The Service cannot find any Pods because no Pods have the label "app=redis" that the Service is looking for.

Solution:
1. Check Pod labels: kubectl get pods --show-labels
2. Add missing label to Pod: kubectl label pod <pod-name> app=redis
3. Or update Service selector to match existing Pod labels
